counterfactuals.name: Descending Price Market Sort from Step 696
counterfactuals.hypothesis: Sorting market sell orders by descending commodity price will clear Wool and Milk ahead of bulk crops, capturing peak prices before V44 depresses the market.
counterfactuals.original_action: Order array: CARROT, EGG, MILK, WOOL
counterfactuals.counterfactual_action: Order array sorted by price: WOOL, MILK, EGG, CARROT
counterfactuals.downstream_mechanism: Delaying crop clearance congests shed capacity (limit 30). Subsequent harvests fail and harvested crops are silently deleted by engine. Fatal casualties induced on near-wins.

counterfactuals.name: Descending Price Market Sort from Step 600
counterfactuals.hypothesis: Early market priority to high value commodities across the entire late game.
counterfactuals.counterfactual_action: Price-sorted sell queue from Step 600 onwards
counterfactuals.downstream_mechanism: Severe shed congestion over 119 steps. Massive inventory loss and price depression.

counterfactuals.name: Pre-Emptive Full Liquidation at Step 696
counterfactuals.hypothesis: Liquidate inventory 1 turn before V44 to capture uncontested market demand.
counterfactuals.original_action: PASS market at Step 696; collect final dairy batch
counterfactuals.counterfactual_action: Execute full market SELL at Step 696
counterfactuals.downstream_mechanism: Premature sale misses the 12-unit terminal milk collection ($256/unit = $3,072 gross loss).

counterfactuals.name: Suppress Step 0 Wheat Wash
counterfactuals.hypothesis: Avoid buying and reselling wheat at Step 0 to preserve liquid cash.
counterfactuals.downstream_mechanism: Desynchronizes the deterministic execution tape of shop-router-0911. Catastrophic strategy breakdown.

summary.conclusion: No micro-intervention exists that flips any of the 4 losses without creating fatal casualties on near-wins.
